title: Data Science Agent — Study 2 paired blind review, one participant record
description: Web plan §12 Study 2, protocol in STUDY2_PAIRED_BLIND.md. One JSON document per participant. No field is pre-filled by the project; every value comes from a real reviewer session. Not conducted yet (PENDING EXTERNAL ACTOR).

converter_used.description: The one converter and flow that produced both delivery files, recorded per the protocol's §3.3.

is_project_author.description: Must be false for the session to count.

participant_index.description: Index within the round; odd means the A document was read first (protocol §4.2).

order.description: Which named file was read first. The file-to-mode mapping lives in the coordinator's pairing key, not here.

documents.description: One entry per document, in reading order.

claims_would_verify.description: How many of the document's claims the reviewer would verify before acting on it.

trust_audited_minus_findings.description: Filled by the coordinator after unblinding, from the two trust ratings and the pairing key.

provenance_verdict.description: The coordinator's classification of the debrief answer, per protocol §4.4. 'hindered' is an expected outcome the product must be able to act on, not a failed study.

help_events.description: Times the coordinator answered a task question, per protocol §4.1.

words_recorded.description: The participant consented to their own words being recorded and archived.

raw_archive_path.description: Where the session's raw record lives, appended under external-validation/ in a dated file.
